speaker: Old Kings' Cairn
description: An Old Kings' cairn at the Hidden Grove (plan M6-M9 §5.4, decision 33): reading it once gives one attribute point (once-flag reward.cairn.hidden_grove).

nodes.text: A cairn grown over with moss in the hidden grove. Under the moss: 'The small find this place. Remember being small.'

choices.text: [Lay a hand on the stones] (+1 attribute point)

nodes.text: An Old Kings' cairn. Its strength is already in you.
